name: 227. DeepSeek structured output downgrades json_schema to json_object (deepseek json schema)
description: DeepSeek's chat endpoint rejects response_format json_schema with HTTP 400 ("This response_format type is unavailable now") and only accepts json_object. Bifrost now sends json_object with the schema carried as a system instruction that names json, so structured-output requests succeed and still return JSON in the requested shape. These cases pin /v1/chat/completions (non-streaming and streaming) and /v1/responses (served through the chat fallback). The /cohere/v2/chat and /langchain ingresses are pinned by the existing 48.5.C and 48.1.G deepseek structured-output rows. Each case is red before the fix (DeepSeek 400) and green after.

item.name: 227.1 deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash /v1/chat/completions response_format json_schema returns schema-shaped JSON (deepseek json schema)

exec: pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'deepseek rejected the json_schema request: ' + pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('no response_format rejection', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text(), pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/response_format type is unavailable/i); });
pm.expect(function () { parsed = JSON.parse(text); }, 'content is not JSON: ' + text).to.not.throw();
pm.expect(parsed, 'content is not a JSON object: ' + text).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(parsed.age, 'missing required integer field age: ' + text).to.be.a('number');
